description: This file defines a data class 'JournalEntryAggregationSummaryData' used for summarizing journal entry aggregations in the context of job processing within the Fineract project. It uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code generation and includes fields related to financial journal entries, such as amounts, dates, account IDs, and metadata.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationSummaryData
classes.description: A data container class that encapsulates summary information for journal entry aggregations, including identifiers, dates, amounts, currency, and other relevant metadata.

methods.description: Facilitates the construction of immutable instances of JournalEntryAggregationSummaryData with a fluent API.
